definitions.explanation: Something given to someone, especially for a special occasion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{贈|おく}り{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{贈|おく}り{物|もの}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This is a gift from a friend.

examples.japanese: {贈|おく}り{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きれいに→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦{包|つつ}んで→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had the gift nicely wrapped.
For Mother's Day gifts, I always choose flowers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{思|おも}いがけない→思いがけない：19375_omoigakenai⟧{贈|おく}り{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらって→もらう：00520_morau⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦うれしかった→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧。
examples.english: I received an unexpected gift and was very happy.

notes:
{贈|おく}り{物|もの} means 'gift' or 'present.'

Formation: ⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧ (to give as a gift) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing)

Similar words:
- {贈|おく}り{物|もの} vs. ⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧: ⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧ is more casual and modern; {贈|おく}り{物|もの} is more formal/traditional
- {贈|おく}り{物|もの} vs. ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧: ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧ specifically refers to souvenirs brought back from trips

Common collocations:
- {贈|おく}り{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give a gift
- {贈|おく}り{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose a gift
